tools.name: break_on_xhr
tools.description: Sets a breakpoint that triggers when an XHR/Fetch request URL contains the specified string.

url.description: URL pattern to break on (partial match).

tools.name: evaluate_script
tools.description:
Evaluate a JavaScript function inside the currently selected page. Returns the response as JSON
so returned values have to JSON-serializable. When execution is paused at a breakpoint, automatically evaluates in the paused call frame context.

mainWorld.description: Execute the function in the page main world instead of the default isolated context. Use this when you need to access page-defined globals (e.g. window.bdms, window.app). The function must be synchronous and return a JSON-serializable value.

frameIndex.description: When paused at a breakpoint, which call frame to evaluate in (0 = top frame). If omitted, uses the top frame. Use get_paused_info to see available frames.

outputFile.description: If provided, saves the evaluation result to this local file path instead of returning it in the chat. Useful for dumping large data, ArrayBuffer, or Uint8Array memory regions. The script should return the data you want to dump.

tools.name: get_paused_info
tools.description: Gets information about the current paused state including call stack, current location, and scope variables. Use this after a breakpoint is hit to understand the execution context.

includeScopes.description: Whether to include scope variables (default: true).

maxScopeDepth.description: Maximum scope depth to traverse (default: 2). 1 = local scope only (function args & local vars), 2 = local + closure scopes, 3+ = all non-global scopes.

frameIndex.description: Which call frame to inspect scope variables for (0 = top frame). Use the call stack indices to pick a frame.

tools.name: get_request_initiator
tools.description: Gets the JavaScript call stack that initiated a network request. This helps trace which code triggered an API call.

requestId.description: The request ID (from list_network_requests) to get the initiator for.

tools.name: get_script_source
tools.description: Gets a small snippet of a JavaScript script source by URL (recommended) or script ID. Supports line range (for normal files) or character offset (for minified single-line files). Prefer using url over scriptId — URLs remain stable across page navigations while script IDs become invalid after reload. IMPORTANT: This tool is designed for reading small code regions (e.g. around breakpoints or search results). You MUST always specify startLine/endLine or offset/length. To read an entire script file (especially minified ones), use save_script_source instead — it downloads the full source and auto-formats minified code for readability. WASM scripts cannot be read by this tool — it will reject them and direct you to save_script_source.

url.description: Script URL (preferred). Stable across page navigations. Exact match first, then substring match.

scriptId.description: Script ID (from list_scripts). Becomes invalid after page navigation — prefer url instead.

startLine.description: Start line number (1-based). Use for multi-line files.

endLine.description: End line number (1-based). Use for multi-line files.

offset.description: Character offset to start from (0-based). Use for minified single-line files.

length.description: Number of characters to return when using offset (default: 1000).

tools.name: get_websocket_messages
tools.description: Lists WebSocket connections or gets messages for a specific connection. Without wsid, lists all connections. With wsid, gets messages. Set analyze=true to group messages by pattern. Use groupId to filter by group. Use frameIndex to get a single message's full detail.

wsid.description: The wsid of the WebSocket connection. If omitted, lists all connections.

analyze.description: Set to true to analyze and group messages by pattern/fingerprint. Returns statistics and sample indices for each message type.

frameIndex.description: Get a single message by its frame index (0-based). Returns full detail for that message.

groupId.description: Filter by group ID (A, B, C, ...). Run with analyze=true first to get group IDs.

pageSize.description: Messages per page (for messages mode) or connections per page (for list mode). Defaults to 10.

show_content.description: Set to true to show full message payload. Default false (summary only) to avoid large binary output.

urlFilter.description: Filter connections by URL (only for listing connections without wsid).

includePreservedConnections.description: Set to true to return the preserved connections over the last 3 navigations (only for listing connections without wsid).

tools.name: list_breakpoints
tools.description: Lists all active breakpoints in the current debugging session. Breakpoints persist across page navigations and are automatically restored after reload/goto/back/forward.

tools.name: list_console_messages
tools.description: List all console messages for the currently selected page since the last navigation. Pass msgid to get a single message by its ID.

msgid.description: The msgid of a console message on the page from the listed console messages

pageSize.description: Maximum number of messages to return. When omitted, returns all requests.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

types.description: Filter messages to only return messages of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all messages.

includePreservedMessages.description: Set to true to return the preserved messages over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: list_network_requests
tools.description: List network requests for the currently selected page since the last navigation. Results are sorted newest-first. By default returns the 20 most recent requests; use pageSize/pageIdx to paginate. Pass reqid to get a single request's full details.

reqid.description: The reqid of a specific network request to get full details for. If omitted, lists all requests.

pageSize.description: Maximum number of requests to return. Defaults to 20.

pageIdx.description: Page number to return (0-based). When omitted, returns the first page.

resourceTypes.description: Filter requests to only return requests of the specified resource types. When omitted or empty, returns all requests.

urlFilter.description: Filter requests by URL. Only requests containing this substring will be returned.

includePreservedRequests.description: Set to true to return the preserved requests over the last 3 navigations.

tools.name: list_scripts
tools.description: Lists all JavaScript scripts loaded in the current page. Returns script ID, URL, and source map information. Use this to find scripts before setting breakpoints or searching. Script IDs are automatically refreshed after page navigation, so listed IDs are always valid.

filter.description: Optional filter string to match against script URLs (case-insensitive partial match).

tools.name: navigate_page
tools.description: Navigates the currently selected page to a URL, or performs back/forward/reload navigation. Waits for DOMContentLoaded event (not full page load). Default timeout is 10 seconds. After navigation, stale script IDs are cleared and fresh ones are captured automatically. All breakpoints (URL, XHR, DOM) are preserved across navigation.

type.description: Navigate the page by URL, back or forward in history, or reload.

ignoreCache.description: Whether to ignore cache on reload.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: new_page
tools.description: Creates a new page and navigates to the specified URL. Waits for DOMContentLoaded event (not full page load). Default timeout is 10 seconds.

url.description: URL to load in a new page.

timeout.description: Maximum wait time in milliseconds. If set to 0, the default timeout will be used.

tools.name: pause_or_resume
tools.description: Toggles JavaScript execution. If paused, resumes execution. If running, pauses execution.

tools.name: remove_breakpoint
tools.description: Removes breakpoints and automatically resumes execution if paused. Pass breakpointId to remove a code breakpoint, url to remove an XHR breakpoint, or neither to remove ALL breakpoints (code + XHR).

breakpointId.description: The breakpoint ID to remove (from list_breakpoints or set_breakpoint_on_text).

url.description: The XHR breakpoint URL pattern to remove.

tools.name: save_script_source
tools.description: Saves the full source code of a JavaScript script to a local file. PREFERRED over get_script_source whenever you need the whole file or want to grep/read a minified script — this tool auto-formats (beautifies) minified .js/.mjs/.ts output via prettier so the saved file is human-readable. Use this for any non-trivial source inspection; only fall back to get_script_source for tiny known regions (e.g. ±20 lines around a breakpoint). Typical workflow: call save_script_source → then use Read on the saved file (or Bash grep / your editor) to inspect it. NOTE: because the saved file is beautified, its line numbers DO NOT match the original script — if you later need to set a breakpoint, use the original URL/scriptId with set_breakpoint_on_text rather than line numbers from the saved file.

url.description: Script URL (preferred). Stable across page navigations. Exact match first, then substring match.

scriptId.description: Script ID (from list_scripts). Becomes invalid after page navigation — prefer url instead.

filePath.description: Local file path to save the script source to. Use a .js/.mjs/.cjs/.jsx/.ts/.tsx extension to enable auto-format (prettier beautify); other extensions save raw source verbatim. For WASM scripts, use a .wasm extension.

format.description: Auto-format JavaScript/TypeScript output with prettier (beautifies minified code). Defaults to true. Set to false to save the raw original source verbatim.

tools.name: search_in_sources
tools.description: Searches for a string or regex pattern in all loaded JavaScript sources. Returns matching lines with script ID, URL, and line number. Use get_script_source with startLine/endLine to view full context around matches.

query.description: The search query (string or regex pattern).

caseSensitive.description: Whether the search should be case-sensitive.

isRegex.description: Whether to treat the query as a regular expression.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 30).

maxLineLength.description: Maximum characters per matched line preview (default: 150). Increase if you need more context around the match.

excludeMinified.description: Skip minified files (files with very long lines). Default: true.

urlFilter.description: Only search scripts whose URL contains this string (case-insensitive).

tools.name: select_frame
tools.description: Lists all frames (including iframes) in the current page. Pass frameIdx to switch execution context to that frame for evaluate_script and other tools.

frameIdx.description: The frame index to select. 0 = main frame. If omitted, lists all frames without changing selection.

tools.name: select_page
tools.description: Lists all open pages in the browser. Pass pageIdx to select a page as context for future tool calls.

pageIdx.description: The index of the page to select. If omitted, lists all pages without changing selection.

tools.name: set_breakpoint_on_text
tools.description: Sets a breakpoint on specific code (function name, statement, etc.) by searching for it and automatically determining the exact position. Works with both normal and minified files. Breakpoints persist across page navigations.

text.description: The code text to find and set breakpoint on (e.g., "function myFunc", "fetchData(", "apiCall").

urlFilter.description: Only search in scripts whose URL contains this string (case-insensitive).

occurrence.description: Which occurrence to break on (1 = first, 2 = second, etc.).

condition.description: Optional condition expression. Breakpoint only triggers when this evaluates to true.

tools.name: step
tools.description: Steps JavaScript execution. Use direction "over" to skip function calls, "into" to enter function bodies, "out" to exit the current function. Returns the new location with source context.

tools.name: take_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of the page or element.

format.description: Type of format to save the screenshot as. Default is "png"

quality.description: Compression quality for JPEG format (0-100). Higher values mean better quality but larger file sizes. Ignored for PNG format.

fullPage.description: If set to true takes a screenshot of the full page instead of the currently visible viewport. Incompatible with uid.

filePath.description: The absolute path, or a path relative to the current working directory, to save the screenshot to instead of attaching it to the response.
